LinkedIn Video Maker initial release — create and export polished LinkedIn videos from your script and headshot in seconds.

- Describe your video idea or upload footage; get a ready-to-post LinkedIn video quickly.
- Automatic session setup: uses NEMO_TOKEN or generates a free 7-day token for new users.
- Supports MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG files up to 500MB.
- Guides users through upload, editing, preview, and export workflows — no video editing experience required.
- Cloud rendering: videos processed and returned in 30–90 seconds.
- Handles credits, error messages, and supported file formats seamlessly.
